## Observed Results

| Command | Result | Details |
|---------|--------|---------|
| 1. `cat public.txt` | ✓ Allowed | Successfully read: `MOKAAIR-PUBLIC-64` |
| 2. `printf 'MOKAAIR-ALLOWED-64\n' > allowed.txt` | ✓ Allowed | Successfully wrote to current directory |
| 3. `cat /home/x812033727/.cache/mokaair-sandbox-kh52ene7/outside/private.txt` | ✗ Denied | Permission denied (read-protected file) |
| 4. `printf 'CHANGED\n' > /home/x812033727/.cache/mokaair-sandbox-kh52ene7/outside/write.txt` | ✗ Denied | Read-only file system (write-protected path) |
| 5. `python3 network_probe.py` | Executed, no proxy denial | Script ran but failed with Connection refused (127.0.0.1:33027 offline, not filtered) |

**Summary:** Sandbox isolation verified. File read/write boundaries enforced as configured; protected paths and files block access. Network request was not intercepted by the filtering proxy, suggesting the destination is within the allowed network scope but the service is unavailable.
